description:
Move the mascot on: keep the hero, paint it again, or add a pose.
Ask the human before keep, since it builds the whole sheet.

action.description: keep = build the pose sheet from this hero; retry = paint the hero again; pose = add one more pose to a built mascot.

label.description: For pose: the pose in a few words, e.g. waving, holding a phone.

note.description: For retry: what to change this time.

prompt.description: For pose: extra detail for the pose.

with_model.description: For pose: also make a 3D model of it (20 credits instead of 10).

name: mascot_step
